conversation.preview: Guided pool arbitrage and draft signal ideas for BTC EMA, volume breakouts and USDC yield gaps; signal rules and feeds require validation before a run.
conversation.production: Restricted agent compiles a general thesis to an editable, typed strategy with validated sources

production_services_required: Pool identity and common quote normalization
Historical prices, liquidity/depth, costs and replay jobs
Persistent polling lifecycle, source freshness, budgets and cadence
Alert crossing/rearm, deduplication and delivery evidence
boundaries: Confirmation in this preview saves configuration locally only.
No historical result or profitability is invented.
No monitor is marked active or scheduled.
No transaction action is part of this Lab flow.
Signal drafts preserve the user condition and source but do not claim executable or validated rules.
A purchase condition creates only a reviewed proposal specification, never a trade.

trigger_presets.title: Watch a pool divergence
trigger_presets.rule: Compare XLM/USDC on Soroswap and Aquarius; evaluate an upward crossing of a 1% price gap with size and impact constraints.

trigger_presets.title: Follow BTC momentum
trigger_presets.rule: BTC/USD daily close crosses from below to above its 20-day EMA; propose an XLM buy for user review once on the crossing.

trigger_presets.title: Catch a volume breakout
trigger_presets.rule: XLM/USD daily close exceeds its previous 30-day high with daily volume above twice its previous 20-day average; alert once on a new breakout.

trigger_presets.title: Watch a better supply rate
trigger_presets.rule: Eligible USDC supply rate exceeds the current venue by 2 percentage points for 24 hours after fees, with enough exit and entry liquidity; alert only.

preset_behavior: Fill the composer for editing; never auto-send, activate monitoring or trade.

strategy_requirements.arbitrage: Exact venues and pool identities, common quoted pair, threshold, sizing, maximum impact and mode-specific time inputs.
strategy_requirements.signal: Original condition, named data source, alert versus reviewed proposal, fixed USDC amount for a purchase proposal, and mode-specific time inputs; rule validation remains pending.
